protocol.scope: 100 large U.S. and territory airports; reporting-carrier domestic events
protocol.selection: Retain the 25 incumbent models. Additional airports use fixed regularized logistic models fit and calibrated only on their own outcomes; no selection on 2026 results.
protocol.calibration: Retain v2 calibration for incumbent airports. Each added airport fits its own sigmoid on model log odds with C=0.02, using only that airport probability-calibration outcomes; no class rebalancing.
protocol.interval: Central signed-residual 80% empirical band from nine months; airport plus predicted-risk bins (<25%,25-50%,50%+) with >=100 windows, otherwise airport fallback. No guarantee under temporal dependence.
protocol.evidence: Moderate requires sample support, positive 95% Brier-skill interval, BH-adjusted approximate bootstrap q <= 0.1 across all tested airport/direction/horizon comparisons within the evaluation period, calibration error <5pp, and band coverage >=75%.
protocol.fairHorizonComparison: Fit and evaluate each horizon on its eligible windows; matched-window results reported separately. Missing 24-hour forecasts do not discard 6/12-hour examples.
limitations: January-February 2026 was not loaded or evaluated in v1, but evaluates winter only
March-June 2026 has been inspected in v1 and is a disclosed stress re-evaluation, never a new holdout
Candidate development validation overlaps the final probability calibration period; final interval calibration and fresh test remain outside selection
Final-vintage BTS outcomes; no release-vintage reconstruction or cancellation announcement time
TAF issue/product time plus lag approximates historical delivery
No private or global flight-outcome transfer
Winter 2026 is retrospective: these dates and some connected flight outcomes were inspected in earlier versions; no new independent prospective accuracy claim
Some catalog airports lack covered domestic passenger outcomes or supported forecast products
protocol.eligibilityDecision: Before fitting or viewing 2026 results: first training-month audit showed a ten-flight minimum excluded many smaller airports. Use all known-outcome windows and flight-count weighting; preserve fit/calibration/test support gates and report empirical band coverage. Incumbent v2 models retain their original ten-flight cohorts.
